paraphrase: Aquinas, ST I-II q.91 a.2: the light of natural reason, by which we discern good and evil (what belongs to the natural law), is nothing but an impression of the divine light in us; and (s.c., with the Gloss on Rom 2:14) the gentiles, though without the written law, have the natural law, by which each understands and is aware of what is good and what is evil.
